Amit Shah's Pune Visit Sees Road Repairs, Protests, and Preventive Custody

Union Home Minister Amit Shah visited Pune, during which the Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) repaired roads. Citizens questioned the timing of these repairs, which occurred shortly before Shah's visit. Rival protests by the Congress and BJP were staged during the visit. Additionally, Pune Police took Vasant More into preventive custody before the event.
